notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.37.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Xet che chan giua cac khoi nhanh hon nhieu: do tia bang BVH rieng chay song song tren moi nhan CPU thay ReferenceIntersector. Model that (nha xuong 100 x 100 m + khoi van phong): truoc ~6 phut va form "Not Responding", nay 6-9 s. Cua di, cua so, thiet bi MEP, noi that khong tinh la vat che nang. - Chu giai mau hien tren view 3D (ban truoc bi an do kich thuoc dai mau = 0): ten ket qua + don vi, gia tri tung nac, dong mo ta che do; dat ben phai cong trinh, keo duoc.
